main.name: survey-nps-aggregate

params.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS responses, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST("推奨度" AS INTEGER) >= 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS promoters, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST("推奨度" AS INTEGER) <= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS detractors FROM data

source.inline: function main(i) { const r = Number(i.responses), p = Number(i.promoters), d = Number(i.detractors); if (!r) throw new Error('回答が 0 件のため NPS を計算できません'); const x = (p - d) / r * 100; return { responses: r, promoters: p, detractors: d, nps: Math.sign(x) * Math.round(Math.abs(x)) }; }
